text:
maria: Heads up — telemetry just flagged a cluster of GPUs with growing page retire/row-remap counts in us-west-2 dedicated pool.
maria: small paste of nvidia-smi excerpt:
```
nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,MEMORY
GPU 0:
  Retired pages                 : 12
  Row remap events              : 7
  ECC errors (corrected)        : 48
GPU 1:
  Retired pages                 : 1
  Row remap events              : 0
```
maria: Nodes affected: gpu-uw2-12 (cards 0,1), gpu-uw2-15 (card 0), gpu-uw2-22 (card 3). All `a100-sxm4-80gb`.
aj: Can you paste node IDs + kernel dmesg Xid snippets? are we seeing Xid 79 or 63?
maria: dmesg snippet from gpu-uw2-12:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:5e:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.568012] nvidia: GPU 0000:5e:00: GPU fault: multiple errors
```
devon: Those row-remap counts growing while corrected ECC accumulates -> classic starting DRAM row deterioration. If retired pages >10 on a card we should assume progressive failure.
oncall-sre: Alert fired: SRE gpu_mem_retire_threshold (4 GPUs) — created incident INC-2026-193. Notifying Dedicated customers impacted by scheduled drain.
aj: I can start draining cards with our tooling. Plan: drain card-level for non-shared tenants, cordon hosts for shared. Roll tonight 02:00 UTC. Impact est ~6% capacity for us-west-2 dedicated pool.
aj: Commands I'll run (dry-run first):
```
./infra-gpu drain --node gpu-uw2-12 --card 0 --reason "row-remap growth" --dry-run
kubectl cordon gpu-uw2-12
./infra-gpu set-inventory --card 0000:5e:00 --state retiring
```

maria: Please also collect pmon and nv-hostengine logs and tar them to /mnt/diag/gpu-uw2-12-2026-03-04.tar.gz and attach to ticket.
aj: opened vendor ticket to NVIDIA: case 987654 — sent logs and pmon traces. nvidia-support-bot: Case acknowledged, RMA likely if hardware shows growth after replacement testing.
devon: Quick mitigation: pin high-SLO workloads to healthy pools in us-east-1, enable fallback routing for Dedicated customers. @product-ops FYI for rollout.
oncall-sre: Scheduling maintenance window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Will post customer-notice and run capacity tests after replacement.
maria: Action items: (1) drain & replace card(s) on listed nodes, (2) expand monitoring rule to alert at retired_pages>=5 (current was 10), (3) run fleet-wide scan for row-remap >0 and produce CSV.
aj: I'll take (1) & (3). devon: I'll update monitoring rule (2) and add histogram of retired pages by model type.
maria: Thanks all. I'll follow up when replacements are done and we have RMA confirmation. :thumbsup:
